outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL ARE EXPECTED FROM PORTIONS OF NEW ENGLAND INTO THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS AND OHIO VALLEY. FARTHER WEST...OTHER SEVERE STORMS WITH LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE IN THE CENTRAL AND NORTHERN HIGH PLAINS LATE THIS AFTERNOON THROUGH THE EVENING. STORMS WILL PROBABLY DEVELOP LATE TONIGHT OVER PARTS OF THE LOWER MISSOURI VALLEY WITH AN ISOLATED LARGE-HAIL THREAT.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER ERN ONTARIO/WRN QUEBEC AND THE LOWER GREAT LAKES WILL MOVE EWD TO THE ST. LAWRENCE SEAWAY AND NEW ENGLAND BY THIS EVENING. A STRONG BELT OF QUASI-ZONAL FLOW WILL BE RELEGATED TO THE NRN TIER OF STATES AS A MID-LEVEL ANTICYCLONE IS CENTERED OVER THE S-CNTRL STATES. IN THE LOW LEVELS...A WARM FRONT WILL ADVANCE NWD THROUGH SRN NEW ENGLAND AS A COLD FRONT WILL MOVE EWD FROM THE LOWER GREAT LAKES AND THROUGH NEW ENGLAND. THE COLD FRONT WILL EXTEND SWWD INTO THE OH VALLEY AND ADVANCE SLOWLY NWD AS A WARM FRONT OVER THE CNTRL PLAINS LATE TONIGHT.

sections.title: NORTHEAST STATES INTO THE MID ATLANTIC
sections.text: A CLUSTER OR TWO OF STORMS WILL LIKELY BE ONGOING OVER PORTIONS OF NEW ENGLAND AND MAY POSE A MARGINAL WIND RISK DURING THE MORNING. IN WAKE OF THE EARLY-DAY STORM ACTIVITY...THE ATMOSPHERE IS EXPECTED TO DESTABILIZE AS RICHER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE IS ADVECTED NEWD BEHIND AN ADVANCING WARM FRONT MOVING THROUGH THE HUDSON VALLEY AND SRN NEW ENGLAND. STRONG DIABATIC HEATING AMIDST BREAKS IN CLOUD COVER WILL YIELD A MODERATELY BUOYANT BOUNDARY LAYER BY EARLY AFTERNOON /1000-1500 J PER KG MLCAPE/. STRONGER DESTABILIZATION IS FORECAST TO OCCUR FARTHER S ACROSS PA/NJ INTO NRN VA WHERE 2000-3000 J PER KG MLCAPE WILL PROBABLY DEVELOP. CONVERGENCE ALONG THE FRONT AND HEATING WILL FOSTER SCATTERED TO NUMEROUS STORMS AS CINH IS REMOVED. THE STRONGER DEEP-LAYER WIND PROFILES WILL REMAIN ACROSS THE NERN U.S. IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE MID-LEVEL WAVE AND SUPPORT ORGANIZED SEVERE STORMS...INCLUDING SUPERCELL TORNADO POTENTIAL. DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WILL DECREASE WITH SWD EXTENT IN THE MID-ATLANTIC /30-40 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR/ BUT SUPPORT THE DEVELOPMENT OF SEVERE MULTICELL LINE SEGMENTS CAPABLE PRIMARILY OF A DAMAGING WIND/LARGE HAIL THREAT. THE FRONT WILL MOVE OFF THE NERN U.S. COAST BY EVENING WITH THE REMA

sections.title: OH VALLEY INTO THE SRN APPALACHIANS
sections.text: MUCH OF THIS REGION WILL RESIDE ON SRN PERIPHERY OF STRONGER WINDS ALOFT WHERE VERTICAL SHEAR WILL SUPPORT PRIMARILY MULTICELL MODES. STRONG DIABATIC WARMING AND DESTABILIZATION OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER WILL LIKELY PROMOTE REDEVELOPMENT OF STORMS ALONG THE CNTRL/SRN APPALACHIANS AND ALONG/AHEAD OF THE SEWD ADVANCING COLD FRONT. ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL WILL BE THE MAIN THREATS FROM DURING THE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING.

sections.title: CNTRL AND NRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: MODIFIED CP AIR WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE 50S WILL RETURN NWD THROUGH THE HIGH PLAINS BENEATH STEEP LAPSE RATES IN WAKE OF RETREATING SURFACE RIDGE. THIS WILL CONTRIBUTE TO AN AXIS OF 500-1500 J/KG MLCAPE. MUCH OF THIS REGION WILL RESIDE BENEATH ZONE OF FASTER WLY ALOFT RESULTING IN 40-50 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR. ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN AND SPREAD EWD INTO THE HIGH PLAINS. SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL AND SEVERE WIND GUSTS APPEAR TO BE THE MAIN THREATS.

sections.title: LOWER TO MID MO VALLEY
sections.text: A LLJ IS FORECAST TO DEVELOP TONIGHT AND VEER/STRENGTHEN AS A STRONG WAA REGIME FOCUSES OVER THE LOWER TO MID MO VALLEY IN THE 06-12Z PERIOD. ISENTROPIC ASCENT AND MOISTENING ON THE FRINGE OF THE STRONG CAPPING INVERSION WILL PROBABLY LEAD TO ISOLATED TO SCATTERED ELEVATED STORMS. STRONG EFFECTIVE SHEAR /35-45 KT/ AND AMPLE ELEVATED CAPE MAY YIELD AN ISOLATED LARGE HAIL THREAT WITH THE STRONGER UPDRAFTS.

sections.title: SERN U.S
sections.text: A LEE TROUGH WILL EXTEND SWWD FROM THE MID-ATLANTIC STATES INTO THE CAROLINAS/GA PIEDMONT. STRONG DIABATIC HEATING AND A MOIST AIRMASS --PW AROUND 2 INCHES-- WILL CONTRIBUTE TO STEEP 0-3 KM LAPSE RATES AND MODERATE TO STRONG BUOYANCY DEVELOPING AS TEMPS WARM INTO THE 90S. WATER-LOADED DOWNDRAFTS WILL PROBABLY RESULT IN WET MICROBURSTS CAPABLE OF 45-60 MPH WIND GUSTS AND POCKETS OF WIND DAMAGE BEFORE THIS ACTIVITY DIMINISHES DURING THE EARLY EVENING. ..SMITH/ROGERS.. 06/23/2015

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH DAMAGING WIND GUSTS...LARGE HAIL AND POSSIBLY A FEW TORNADOES ARE EXPECTED FROM PORTIONS OF NEW ENGLAND INTO THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS AND OHIO VALLEY. FARTHER WEST...OTHER SEVERE STORMS WITH LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE IN THE CENTRAL AND NORTHERN HIGH PLAINS LATE THIS AFTERNOON THROUGH THE EVENING. STORMS WILL PROBABLY DEVELOP LATE TONIGHT OVER PARTS OF THE LOWER MISSOURI VALLEY WITH AN ISOLATED LARGE-HAIL THREAT.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: THE PRIMARY BELT OF POLAR WESTERLIES WILL REMAIN CONFINED TO THE NRN TIER OF STATES...TO THE NORTH OF AN ELONGATED MID-LEVEL HIGH CENTERED OVER THE S-CNTRL CONUS. EMBEDDED WITHIN THIS HIGH-MOMENTUM AIR STREAM...A POTENT SHORT-WAVE TROUGH WILL PROGRESS FROM THE ONTARIO-QUEBEC BORDER TOWARD THE CANADIAN MARITIMES WITH A CORRIDOR OF WEAK HEIGHT FALLS OVERSPREADING THE NERN U.S. LATER TODAY INTO TONIGHT. ELSEWHERE...A SERIES OF LOW-AMPLITUDE PERTURBATIONS WILL TRANSLATE ESEWD FROM THE NRN INTERMOUNTAIN REGION INTO NRN PLAINS. AT THE SURFACE...THE COLD FRONT RELATED TO THE ERN CANADA TROUGH WILL ADVANCE SEWD THROUGH THE NERN STATES AND MID ATLANTIC REGION...WHILE MOVING MORE SLY SWD THROUGH THE OH INTO TN VALLEYS. MEANWHILE...THE WRN EXTENSION OF THIS FRONT WILL SHIFT NWD THROUGH THE CNTRL PLAINS IN RESPONSE TO FALLING SURFACE PRESSURES IN THE LEE OF THE NRN AND CNTRL ROCKIES.

sections.title: NERN U.S. TODAY INTO THIS EVENING
sections.text: SIMILAR TO YESTERDAY OVER THE GREAT LAKES...CONSIDERABLE EARLY-DAY PRECIPITATION AND CLOUDS FROM NY AND PA INTO NEW ENGLAND...CASTS UNCERTAINTY ON THE DEGREE OF AIR MASS RECOVERY THAT WILL OCCUR AHEAD OF THE FRONT THIS AFTERNOON. IN FACT...A NUMBER OF 00Z/06Z CONVECTION-ALLOWING AND PARAMETRIZED MODELS ARE DEFICIENT IN THE EXTENT OF STORMS CURRENTLY MOVING ACROSS SRN NY AND NRN PA...WHICH COULD HAVE SUBSTANTIAL RAMIFICATIONS ON THE DISTRIBUTION OF INSTABILITY LATER TODAY. IN THE NEAR-TERM...THE LEADING EDGE OF THE NY/PA MCS MAY INTENSIFY LATER THIS MORNING AS IT MOVES INTO THE MID/LOWER HUDSON VALLEY AND ENCOUNTERS A WARMING AND MOISTENING BOUNDARY LAYER. GIVEN THE VERY STRONG WIND FIELD IN PLACE PER 12Z RAOBS AND REGIONAL VAD DATA...THIS INTENSIFICATION WOULD SIGNAL A CORRESPONDING INCREASE IN DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL. LATER TODAY...ADDITIONAL STORMS WILL ATTEMPT TO DEVELOP ALONG AND AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT SWEEPING EWD THROUGH THE LOWER GREAT LAKES. THE COVERAGE AND INTENSITY OF THESE STORMS WILL BE DICTATED BY THE AMOUNT OF DESTABILIZATION THAT CAN OCCUR. DUE TO THE VERY STRONG VERTICAL SHEAR...A CONDITIONAL RISK FOR SUPERCELLS AND BOWING LINE SEGMENTS WILL EXIST WITH AN ATTENDAN

sections.title: MID-ATLANTIC INTO THE OH VALLEY THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING
sections.text: WHILE THE REGION WILL LIE ON THE SRN PERIPHERY OF STRONGER FLOW FIELDS AND FORCING FOR ASCENT...ABUNDANT SUNSHINE AND THE PRESENCE OF A MOIST BOUNDARY WILL PROMOTE THE DEVELOPMENT OF MODERATE INSTABILITY BY AFTERNOON WITH MLCAPE OF 1500-2000+ J/KG. CONVERGENCE ALONG THE LEE TROUGH AND CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ASSOCIATED WITH THE NY/PA MCS WILL CONTRIBUTE TO AN INCREASE IN STORM COVERAGE THROUGH THIS AFTERNOON AMIDST THE DESTABILIZING AIR MASS. THE MOST FAVORABLE OVERLAP OF INSTABILITY AND MODERATELY STRONG VERTICAL SHEAR WILL EXIST ACROSS PA/NJ SWWD INTO THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS WHERE SUPERCELLS AND BOWING STRUCTURES MAY EVOLVE WITHIN ONE OR MULTIPLE SEWD-MOVING CONVECTIVE BANDS. WHILE DAMAGING OUTFLOW WINDS WILL BE THE MAIN HAZARD...SOME SEVERE HAIL AND PERHAPS A BRIEF TORNADO ARE ALSO POSSIBLE.

sections.title: NRN/CNTRL HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT
sections.text: STRENGTHENING SELY LOW-LEVEL WILL PROMOTE THE NWWD FLUX OF AN INCREASINGLY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER THROUGH THE REGION AND BENEATH A PLUME OF STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WITH AFTERNOON MLCAPE APPROACHING 1000-2000 J/KG. LOW-LEVEL UPSLOPE FLOW INTO FAVORED TERRAIN AND CONVERGENCE ALONG THE LEE TROUGH WILL BE AUGMENTED BY FORCING ATTENDANT TO WEAK IMPULSES ALOFT TO FOSTER ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED STORM DEVELOPMENT LATER TODAY. VERTICALLY VEERING WIND PROFILES WITH 50-60 KT OF DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WILL BE QUITE SUPPORTIVE OF SUPERCELL STRUCTURES WITH THE PRIMARY HAZARD BEING LARGE HAIL. SOME CONSOLIDATION OF STORMS INTO CLUSTERS MAY OCCUR BY EVENING WITH THE RISK FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS SPREADING SEWD INTO LOWER ELEVATIONS.

sections.title: MID/LOWER MO VALLEY TONIGHT
sections.text: WAA/ISENTROPIC ASCENT WILL INCREASE MARKEDLY AFTER SUNSET TO THE NORTH OF THE SURFACE FRONT AND WITHIN THE EXIT REGION OF A NOCTURNALLY STRENGTHENING LLJ. ELEVATED TSTMS APPEAR MOST PROBABLY WITHIN THIS ZONE OF LOW-LEVEL FORCING ALONG THE ERN EDGE OF STRONGER MID-LEVEL CAPPING FROM PORTIONS OF ERN NEB INTO MO. GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES MUCAPE OF 1000-2000+ J/KG AND AMPLE EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR...THE SETUP WILL BE SUPPORTIVE OF ELEVATED SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF MAINLY LARGE HAIL. ..MEAD/MOSIER.. 06/23/2015

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH DAMAGING WIND GUSTS...LARGE HAIL AND POSSIBLY A COUPLE OF TORNADOES ARE EXPECTED FROM PORTIONS OF NEW ENGLAND INTO THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS AND OHIO VALLEY. FARTHER WEST...A FEW SEVERE STORMS WITH LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE IN THE CENTRAL AND NORTHERN HIGH PLAINS LATE THIS AFTERNOON THROUGH THE EVENING. HAIL WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE TODAY AND TONIGHT WITH STORMS ACROSS THE MID/LOWER MISSOURI VALLEY AREA.

sections.title: THE NORTHEAST/MID-ATLANTIC/OHIO VALLEY AREA
sections.text: COMPLEX CONVECTIVE SCENARIO IS EVIDENT ACROSS THE AREA THIS AFTERNOON...AS EARLY CONVECTION HAS ALTERED THE PRE-FRONTAL ENVIRONMENT ACROSS NY AND INTO VT/NY/ME. ATTM...IT APPEARS THAT THE ZONE OF GREATEST SEVERE RISK -- COINCIDENT WITH THE ENHANCED RISK AREA -- EXTENDS FROM WV/SRN PA EWD/NEWD INTO PARTS OF SRN NEW ENGLAND...ALONG THE SRN PERIPHERY OF EARLIER/ONGOING STORMS WHERE A VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER CONTINUES TO HEAT/DESTABILIZE FAIRLY AGGRESSIVELY. EXPECT STORMS TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE/INTENSITY THROUGH THE AFTERNOON -- AIDED BY RELATIVELY STRONG WLY FLOW THROUGH A DEEP LAYER. GIVEN THE QUASI-UNIDIRECTIONAL NATURE OF THE FLOW FIELD...CLUSTERS OF FAST-MOVING STORMS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL WILL LIKELY PREVAIL...THOUGH WELL-ORGANIZED/ISOLATED STORMS WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE GIVEN FLOW FIELD SUPPORTIVE OF UPDRAFT ROTATION. RISK WILL GRADUALLY DIMINISH FROM W-E AS THE COLD FRONT ENTERING THE NORTHEAST ATTM MOVES STEADILY TOWARD THE COAST.

sections.title: NORTHERN AND CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: ISOLATED STORM DEVELOPMENT MAY OCCUR OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN THIS AFTERNOON...AS A MODESTLY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZES GRADUALLY IN CONJUNCTION WITH DAYTIME HEATING. WHILE COVERAGE WILL LIKELY REMAIN SOMEWHAT SPARSE THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON...MODERATE MID-LEVEL WLYS ATOP SELY BOUNDARY LAYER FLOW WILL RESULT IN SHEAR SUFFICIENT FOR ORGANIZED/ROTATING UPDRAFTS -- AND ATTENDANT HAIL/WIND RISK. POSSIBLE UPSCALE GROWTH INTO A SMALL MCS MAY OCCUR TONIGHT INVOF NERN WY/SERN MT/WRN SD AS A SELY LOW-LEVEL JET DEVELOPS -- WHERE RISK FOR HAIL AND LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS WOULD BE POSSIBLE.

sections.title: NERN KS/SERN NEB EWD INTO SWRN IA/NRN MO
sections.text: SCATTERED ELEVATED STRONG/LOCALLY SEVERE STORMS CONTINUE ACROSS SRN NEB/NERN KS ATTM...AND SHOULD CONTINUE OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS -- ALONG WITH ONGOING RISK FOR HAIL. WHILE SOME DECREASE IN CONVECTIVE COVERAGE/INTENSITY MAY OCCUR THIS AFTERNOON...ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT MAY OCCUR THIS EVENING...ALONG WITH RISK FOR LARGE HAIL. ..GOSS/COOK.. 06/23/2015

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH DAMAGING WIND GUSTS...LARGE HAIL AND POSSIBLY A COUPLE OF TORNADOES WILL PERSIST THROUGH EARLY EVENING FROM PORTIONS OF NEW ENGLAND INTO THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS AND OHIO VALLEY. FARTHER WEST...A FEW SEVERE STORMS WITH LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE REMAIN POSSIBLE IN THE CENTRAL AND NORTHERN HIGH PLAINS THE REMAINDER OF THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. LARGE HAIL WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE TODAY AND TONIGHT WITH ADDITIONAL STORMS EXPECTED ACROSS THE MID/LOWER MISSOURI VALLEY AREA.

sections.title: NERN STATES
sections.text: THE ATMOSPHERE CONTINUES TO DESTABILIZE IN WAKE OF MORNING MCS AND SOUTH OF WARM FRONT EXTENDING FROM NERN VT INTO SERN MAINE. STORMS ARE INITIATING ALONG AND AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT THAT EXTENDS ACROSS WRN NY. ACTIVITY EXISTS WITHIN AN ENVIRONMENT WHERE EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR /40-50 KT/ IS ENHANCED BY A MID-LEVEL JET MOVING THROUGH BASE OF A PROGRESSIVE SHORTWAVE TROUGH CENTERED OVER SRN QUEBEC. WV IMAGERY SHOWS A PRONOUNCED MID-UPPER DRY SLOT SPREADING EWD THROUGH NRN NY AND NRN NEW ENGLAND...AND THIS MIGHT TEND TO MITIGATE UPDRAFT INTENSITY THROUGH DRY ENTRAINMENT TO SOME DEGREE...WHICH MAY SERVE AS AN OVERALL LIMITING FACTOR OVER NRN NEW ENGLAND. MORE ROBUST ROTATING UPDRAFTS ARE MORE LIKELY TO PERSIST THIS AFTERNOON A LITTLE FARTHER SOUTH ACROSS SRN NEW ENGLAND THROUGH ERN PA AND INTO NJ WHERE GREATER INSTABILITY EXISTS WITHIN AN ENVIRONMENT FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS.

sections.title: OH VALLEY THROUGH MID-ATLANTIC
sections.text: STORMS WITH BOTH MULTICELL AND SUPERCELL CHARACTERISTICS DEVELOPING ALONG A COLD FRONT OVER THE OH VALLEY AND OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF THE CNTRL/SRN APPALACHIANS WILL CONTINUE TO POSE A THREAT FOR MAINLY DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL INTO EARLY EVENING AS THEY MOVE SEWD THROUGH THE MODERATELY UNSTABLE WARM SECTOR. REF SWOMCD 1140 FOR MORE INFORMATION.

sections.title: NRN AND CNTRL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: POTENTIAL STILL REMAINS FOR STORMS TO DEVELOP OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN AND SPREAD EWD INTO THE HIGH PLAINS WHERE MLCAPE TO 1500 J/KG AND 40-50 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR WILL SUPPORT A FEW SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND THE MAIN THREATS. ..DIAL.. 06/23/2015 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1137 AM CDT TUE JUN 23 2015/

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS CAPABLE PRIMARILY OF DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL PERSIST OVER THE MID-ATLANTIC STATES THROUGH THE MID EVENING. FARTHER WEST...A FEW SEVERE STORMS WITH LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE REMAIN POSSIBLE IN WESTERN DAKOTAS AND THE NORTH-CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS THIS EVENING AND TONIGHT. ISOLATED LARGE HAIL IS POSSIBLE TONIGHT WITH ADDITIONAL STORMS EXPECTED ACROSS THE MID/LOWER MISSOURI VALLEY AREA.

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS FOR DELMARVA AND VA
sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS LOWER TO MID MO VALLEY...

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS FOR THE HIGH PLAINS OF CO
sections.text: ...THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM THE NRN PLAINS INTO THE TN VALLEY AND MID-ATLANTIC STATES...

sections.title: THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS FOR SRN NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: ...SUMMARY... SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS CAPABLE PRIMARILY OF DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL PERSIST OVER THE MID-ATLANTIC STATES THROUGH THE MID EVENING. FARTHER WEST...A FEW SEVERE STORMS WITH LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE REMAIN POSSIBLE IN WESTERN DAKOTAS AND THE NORTH-CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS THIS EVENING AND TONIGHT. ISOLATED LARGE HAIL IS POSSIBLE TONIGHT WITH ADDITIONAL STORMS EXPECTED ACROSS THE MID/LOWER MISSOURI VALLEY AREA.

sections.title: MID-ATLANTIC STATES
sections.text: A SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER NERN STATES WILL MOVE EWD INTO THE CANADIAN MARITIMES BY WEDNESDAY MORNING WHILE THE SRN FRINGE OF STRONGER MID-LEVEL FLOW GLANCES THE MID-ATLANTIC STATES THIS EVENING/TONIGHT. THE 24/00Z WAL RAOB SHOWED A VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER /16 G PER KG LOWEST 100 MB MEAN MIXING RATIO/ CONTRIBUTING TO STRONG BUOYANCY. DESPITE THE LOSS OF HEATING...SUFFICIENT EFFECTIVE SHEAR /25-35 KT/ WILL SUPPORT A CONTINUED SEVERE WIND GUST/DAMAGE THREAT WITH LINE SEGMENTS AS THEY MOVE EWD ACROSS THIS REGION. MUCH OF THIS ACTIVITY WILL BEGIN TO WEAKEN BY MID EVENING AS IT MOVES OFFSHORE AND THE STORM ACTIVITY FARTHER W OF THE SHENANDOAH VALLEY MOVES INTO THE VA PIEDMONT.

sections.title: CNTRL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: ISOLD TO SCTD STORMS OVER THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS TO THE N OF A FRONT AND LOCATED WITHIN MOIST/ELY UPSLOPE FLOW WILL LIKELY YIELD A LOCALIZED WIND/LARGE HAIL RISK THIS EVENING. THE 24/00Z DNR RAOB EXHIBITED VERY STEEP TROPOSPHERIC LAPSE RATES. VEERING AND INCREASING FLOW WITH HEIGHT MAY RESULT IN SEVERAL ORGANIZED STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS. THE LACK OF APPRECIABLE UPPER FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL LIKELY LEAD TO A DIMINISHING OF STORM VIGOR/INTENSITY LATER THIS EVENING.

sections.title: NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: THE PREFRONTAL WARM SECTOR IS BECOMING INCREASINGLY CONFINED TO SRN NEW ENGLAND THIS EVENING AS SEVERAL CLUSTERS OF STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS MOVE ACROSS CT/RI/MA IN THE 01-03Z TIMEFRAME. ALTHOUGH A TORNADO CANNOT BE RULED OUT BEFORE STORMS MOVE OFF THE COAST...ISOLD STRONG DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREAT.

sections.title: WRN DAKOTAS AND N-CNTRL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: A CLUSTER OF STRONG STORMS OVER SWRN ND THIS EVENING HAVE DEVELOPED WITHIN A LEE TROUGH AND MOIST AXIS OF 50S DEWPOINTS. A FEW OF THESE STORMS MAY YIELD A LARGE HAIL/STRONG WIND GUST BEFORE GRADUALLY WEAKENING THIS EVENING. LATER TONIGHT...A MINOR MID-LEVEL PERTURBATION MOVING EWD WITHIN A BELT OF STRONG ZONAL FLOW OVER THE NRN ROCKIES WILL MOVE INTO THE N-CNTRL HIGH PLAINS. THE POSSIBILITY FOR A FEW STORMS TO DEVELOP MAY RESULT IN A COUPLE OF STRONG STORMS CAPABLE OF A HAIL/WIND RISK.

sections.title: SRN APPALACHIANS AND TN VALLEY
sections.text: VERY MOIST LOW LEVELS SAMPLED THE 24/00Z BNA RAOB HAS YIELDED A VERY UNSTABLE AIRMASS ACROSS THIS REGION. THIS REGION IS DISPLACED FROM THE STRONGER FORCING/SHEAR LOCATED TO THE N/NE. A COUPLE OF WET MICROBURSTS CAPABLE OF MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND POCKETS OF WIND DAMAGE MAY OCCUR BEFORE CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING AND BOUNDARY LAYER STABILIZATION OCCURS BY LATE EVENING. ..SMITH.. 06/24/2015

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS PARTS OF SOUTHEAST NY /INTO DELAWARE AND SULLIVAN COUNTIES NY/ AND NORTHEAST PA ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF THE FORWARD-PROPAGATING MCS. MEANWHILE...A THREAT FOR HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS ARE POSSIBLE WITH STORMS MOVING EWD FROM WRN INTO CENTRAL PA THROUGH 15Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 1220Z...MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY INDICATED THE LEAD STORMS ATTENDANT TO THE NRN PA/SRN NY FORWARD-PROPAGATING MCS HAD EXITED WW 340...AND ALTHOUGH IT HAD BEEN INDICATING A WEAKENING TREND PRIOR TO EXITING THIS WATCH...RECENT TRENDS SUGGEST SOME INCREASE IN STORM INTENSITIES. THE DOWNSTREAM ENVIRONMENT WILL CONTINUE TO DESTABILIZE THAT COULD SUPPORT A LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUST. HOWEVER...GIVEN THE FAST EWD MOVEMENT OF THESE STORMS AT 55-60 KT...THE COUPLING OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER MAY NOT OCCUR SOON ENOUGH TO ENHANCE THE THREAT FOR SEVERE WIND GUSTS PRIOR TO THE STORMS MOVING INTO THE HUDSON VALLEY. MEANWHILE...A FEW STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WITH MAINLY A THREAT FOR HAIL AND/OR STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE THROUGH 15Z ACROSS THE SOUTHWEST PORTION OF WW 340 /IN CENTRAL PA/ AS STORMS CONTINUE TO DEVELOP OVER ERN OH/WRN PA AND MOVE INTO CENTRAL PA THIS MORNING. MODERATE INSTABILITY AND STRONG BULK SHEAR ARE SUPPORTIVE FOR ORGANIZED SEVERE STORMS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A NEW SEVERE TSTM WATCH IS BEING CONSIDERED FOR SOUTHEAST NY INTO SOUTHERN NEW ENGLAND. A FAST-MOVING LINE OF STORMS IN SOUTHEAST NY AND NORTHEAST PA IS EXPECTED TO MOVE INTO THE SOUTHERN EXTENT OF THE HUDSON VALLEY BETWEEN 13-14Z AND THEN TRACK ACROSS SRN NEW ENGLAND BETWEEN 14-16Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT TRENDS IN MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY AND MRMS-CAPPI SUGGEST STORMS ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF A FAST EWD-MOVING LINE OF STORMS /CURRENTLY IN DELAWARE COUNTY NY/ WAS BEGINNING TO RE-INTENSIFY AGAIN. SURFACE HEATING OF A MOIST DOWNSTREAM AIR MASS COUPLED WITH STRONG WIND FIELDS SUGGEST STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL BE A PRIMARY SEVERE WEATHER THREAT THROUGH THE MORNING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DAMAGING WIND AND SEVERE HAIL POTENTIAL IS EXPECTED TO STEADILY INCREASE ACROSS WESTERN PA AND SOUTHERN/EASTERN OH INTO PORTIONS OF WV/NORTHEAST KY AND FAR WESTERN MD. A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH MAY BE NEEDED WITHIN THE HOUR FOR AT LEAST PORTIONS OF THIS REGION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WIDELY SCATTERED BANDS OF THUNDERSTORMS HAVE BEGUN TO INTENSIFY FROM CENTRAL OH INTO WESTERN PA AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT. WHILE SOME CLOUD COVER PRECEDES THE FRONT...THE BOUNDARY LAYER CONTINUES TO STEADILY WARM INTO THE LOWER 80S F AND A MOIST AIR MASS IS IN PLACE WITH NEAR 70 F SURFACE DEWPOINTS. REGIONAL 12Z OBSERVED SOUNDINGS FROM PITTSBURGH AND WILMINGTON OH REFLECT VERY STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND RELATIVELY STRONG MID-LEVEL WESTERLY WINDS...WITH 50+ KT WINDS EVIDENT AROUND 3 KM AGL PER THE 12Z PITTSBURGH RAOB. ADDITIONAL HEATING WILL QUICKLY ERODE INHIBITION...WITH A RELATED INCREASE/INTENSIFICATION OF STORMS LIKELY INTO THE AFTERNOON. WHILE MULTICELLS MAY BE DOMINANT...SUFFICIENT VERTICAL SHEAR/BUOYANCY COULD ALLOW FOR A FEW SPLITTING SUPERCELLS WITH A SEVERE HAIL RISK ASIDE FROM DAMAGING WINDS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: PERIODIC SEVERE HAIL MAY REMAIN A POSSIBILITY THROUGH THE LATE MORNING/EARLY AFTERNOON HOURS ACROSS SOUTHEAST NEB/NORTHEAST KS TO EXTREME SOUTHWEST IA/NORTHWEST MO. A WATCH IS NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED...BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ELEVATED ISOLATED STRONGER/SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS CONTINUE TO OCCUR NEAR AND JUST NORTH OF THE NORTHEAST KS/SOUTHEAST NEB BORDER AS OF 1530Z/1030AM CDT. THIS ACTIVITY APPEARS TO BE AIDED BY WEAK WARM ADVECTION WITHIN AN ELEVATED FRONTAL ZONE...WITH ELEVATED UPDRAFTS LIKELY ROOTED NEAR/ABOVE 850 MB. AS NOTED IN EARLY DAY OBSERVED SOUNDINGS...VERY STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND AMPLE CLOUD-LAYER SHEAR MAY REMAIN SUPPORTIVE OF ISOLATED INSTANCES OF SEVERE HAIL THROUGH LATE MORNING/EARLY AFTERNOON. CURRENT THINKING IS THAT THE OVERALL HAIL RISK SHOULD REMAIN RELATIVELY ISOLATED/MARGINAL...SUCH THAT A WATCH ISSUANCE IS CURRENTLY THOUGHT TO BE UNLIKELY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS MAINLY CAPABLE OF ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS/SOME SEVERE HAIL ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP INTO THE REGION LATER THIS AFTERNOON. WHILE THERE IS SOME UNCERTAINTY REGARDING THE TIMING OF THE MAIN SEVERE THREAT...A WATCH ISSUANCE SEEMS INCREASINGLY LIKELY BY MID/LATE AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WELL AHEAD OF AN UPSTREAM COLD FRONT ACROSS THE MIDDLE/OH RIVER VALLEY...THE AIR MASS CONTINUES TO STEADILY HEAT/DESTABILIZE ACROSS THE REGION NEAR/EAST OF A SURFACE TROUGH IN THE LEE OF THE APPALACHIANS. TEMPERATURES HAVE GENERALLY EXCEEDED 90F AS OF 17Z ACROSS MUCH OF VA/EASTERN MD AND DE/SOUTHERN NJ...WITH MLCAPE ALREADY ESTIMATED TO BE IN EXCESS OF 2500-3000 J/KG AS LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES CONTINUE TO STEEPEN. WHILE EARLIER AFTERNOON/LEE-SIDE ISOLATED DEVELOPMENT CANNOT BE RULED OUT...THE MOST PROBABLE SCENARIO IS EXPECTED TO BE THE EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD SPREAD OF UPSTREAM STORMS /INCREASING ACROSS PA AND NORTHERN WV EARLY THIS AFTERNOON/ INTO THE REGION LATER THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. WITH THE REGION ON THE SOUTHERN PERIPHERY OF STRONGER WESTERLIES ALOFT...SUFFICIENT VERTICAL SHEAR/BACKGROUND FLOW WILL ALLOW FOR THE PERSISTENCE OF EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD-MOVING STRONG/SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS. DAMAGING WINDS/SOME SEVERE HAIL WILL BE A POSSIBILITY COINCIDENT WITH A HOT/UNSTABLE AIR MASS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AT LEAST ISOLATED STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO REDEVELOP/INCREASE THROUGH MID/LATE AFTERNOON FROM EASTERN NY INTO PORTIONS OF NEW ENGLAND. AN ADDITIONAL/REPLACEMENT WATCH WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED LATER THIS AFTERNOON FOR AT LEAST PORTIONS OF THE REGION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: IN THE WAKE OF EARLY DAY CONVECTION/CLOUD COVER...MODEST AIR MASS RECOVERY/DESTABILIZATION CONTINUES TO GRADUALLY OCCUR PARTICULARLY ACROSS EASTERN NY INTO SOUTHERN/FAR WESTERN NEW ENGLAND AS OF MID-AFTERNOON AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT...WITH A RELATED INCREASE IN SHOWERS/SOME THUNDERSTORMS ACROSS EASTERN NY AS OF 245 PM EDT/1845Z. STORMS SHOULD CONTINUE TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE/INTENSITY THE REMAINDER OF THE AFTERNOON...WITH AT LEAST GLANCING INFLUENCES OF AN EASTWARD-MOVING UPPER TROUGH OVER SOUTHERN QUEBEC. THIS INTENSIFICATION COULD INCLUDE THE POTENTIAL FOR SOME SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF SEVERE HAIL AND POSSIBLY A TORNADO RISK...PARTICULARLY GIVEN THE STRENGTH OF LOWER/MIDDLE TROPOSPHERIC WINDS...EVEN WITH A TENDENCY FOR LOW-LEVEL VEERING. THE EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD SPREAD OF MULTICELLS/EVOLVING LINEAR BANDS MAY ULTIMATELY BE THE MORE PREVALENT CONCERN AS STORMS INCREASE/SPREAD EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD THROUGH THE EARLY/MID-EVENING HOURS. ..GUYER.. 06/23/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO OCCASIONALLY SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE POSSIBLE IN THE DISCUSSION AREA OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS...WITH DOWNBURSTS AND HAIL THE MOST LIKELY THREATS. WW ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED FOR THIS ACTIVITY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS HAVE INCREASED IN INTENSITY OVER THE PAST 1-1.5 HOURS IN THE DISCUSSION AREA. DOWNBURSTS APPROACHING SEVERE LIMITS APPEAR THE BE THE PRIMARY THREAT WITH THIS ACTIVITY AS STORMS HAVE FORMED IN AN ENVIRONMENT CHARACTERIZED BY A WELL-MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER AND DEWPOINT DEPRESSIONS APPROACHING 35F...ESPECIALLY IN NORTHERN PARTS OF THE DISCUSSION AREA. HAIL IS ALSO POSSIBLE IN THE STRONGEST STORMS GIVEN THE 500-1000 J/KG MUCAPE ACROSS THE REGION. INSTABILITY IS PROGRESSIVELY WEAKER WITH NORTHEASTWARD EXTENT...WHICH SHOULD LIMIT SPATIAL THREAT OF ANY SEVERE WIND/HAIL. GIVEN THE LIMITED BUOYANCY AND ISOLATED NATURE OF THE THREAT...A WW WILL LIKELY NOT BE NEEDED FOR THIS AREA.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO PRODUCE STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUSTS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL. WW NOT ANTICIPATED FOR THIS ACTIVITY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SCATTERED STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS HAVE DEVELOPED IN PARTS OF THE DISCUSSION AREA OVER THE PAST HOUR. ALTHOUGH DEEP SHEAR IS A BIT MEAGER FOR ORGANIZED ACTIVITY...STORMS APPEAR TO HAVE MERGED ALONG A SLOWLY SOUTHWARD-MOVING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY/GUST FRONT...WHICH MAY LOCALLY ENHANCE THE THREAT FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS IN/NEAR THE STRONGEST STORMS. THE SEVERE THREAT WILL CONTINUE FOR AT LEAST THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS ON AN ISOLATED BASIS GIVEN THE STRONG INSTABILITY AND LITTLE OR NO INHIBITION IN PLACE...ALTHOUGH RAIN-COOLED/STABILIZED AIR ACROSS SOUTHEASTERN GEORGIA AND THE IMMEDIATE FLORIDA GULF COAST MAY TEMPER THE THREAT IN THOSE AREAS. A WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED DUE TO THE ISOLATED AND BRIEF NATURE OF THE THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE POTENTIAL FOR MAINLY DAMAGING WINDS/SOME SEVERE HAIL WILL CONTINUE TO SPREAD EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING ACROSS FAR SOUTHEAST OH/MUCH OF WV/WESTERN MD AND SOUTHERN PA/PORTIONS OF NJ. SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCHES 342/343 CONTINUE UNTIL 23Z/02Z RESPECTIVELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORMS CONTINUE TO STEADILY INCREASE IN COVERAGE/INTENSITY PARTICULARLY ACROSS SOUTHWEST/SOUTH-CENTRAL PA AND SOUTHEAST OH AND WESTERN/NORTHERN WV INTO FAR WESTERN MD AS OF 315 PM EDT/1915Z. AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT...A FAVORABLE COLLOCATION OF MODERATELY STRONG BUOYANCY /2000+ J PER KG MLCAPE/ AND STRONG/LARGELY UNIDIRECTIONAL WEST-SOUTHWESTERLY DEEP-LAYER WINDS WILL CONTINUE TO YIELD SUSTAINED MULTICELLS/EVOLVING LINE SEGMENTS AND POSSIBLY A FEW TRANSIENT/SPLITTING SUPERCELLS. DAMAGING WINDS/SOME SEVERE HAIL WILL REMAIN CONCERNS THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING AS STORMS CONTINUE TO SPREAD EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS THE REGION. ..GUYER.. 06/23/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE RISK WILL CONTINUE TO STEADILY SPREAD EASTWARD/INCREASE THROUGH THE LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING HOURS ACROSS PORTIONS OF CT/RI/MASS INTO NH/SOUTHERN MAINE. THIS INCLUDES THE POTENTIAL FOR A COUPLE OF TORNADOES ASIDE FROM DAMAGING WINDS/HAIL. TORNADO WATCH 345 CONTINUES UNTIL 03Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A MIXED-MODE OF RELATIVELY FAST-MOVING STORMS...INCLUDING A COUPLE OF SPLITTING SUPERCELLS AND SUSTAINED LINEAR SEGMENTS...CONTINUE TO SHOW SIGNS OF INTENSIFICATION AS THEY SPREAD GENERALLY EASTWARD ACROSS CT/MASS/RI AND THE HUDSON RIVER VALLEY AS OF 430 PM EDT/2030Z. THE AIR MASS NEAR/EAST OF A PRE-FRONTAL SURFACE TROUGH...AND ALONG/SOUTH OF AN OUTFLOW-AIDED WARM FRONT ACROSS NH/EXTREME NORTHEAST MASS AND SOUTHWEST NH...CONTINUES TO STEADILY DESTABILIZE WITH 80S SURFACE TEMPERATURES AND NEAR 70 F SURFACE DEWPOINTS CONTRIBUTING TO AS MUCH AS 1500+ J/KG MLCAPE ACROSS SOUTHERN NEW ENGLAND. OVERALL SCENARIO WILL REMAIN SUPPORTIVE OF SOME SPLITTING SUPERCELLS AND FAST-MOVING LINE SEGMENTS AS STORMS CONTINUE TO DEVELOP GENERALLY EASTWARD. WHILE LOW-LEVEL WINDS HAVE TENDED TO VEER...SOUTHWESTERLY WINDS JUST ABOVE THE SURFACE REMAIN QUITE STRONG WITH WSR-88D VWP DATA FROM BOSTON SUPPORTIVE OF NEARLY 200 M2/S2 0-1 KM SRH. WHILE DAMAGING WINDS AND ISOLATED BOUTS OF SEVERE HAIL WILL BE THE MOST PREVALENT CONCERNS...A COUPLE OF TORNADOES WILL BE POSSIBLE WITHIN THE WARM SECTOR...AND PERHAPS ESPECIALLY ANY STORMS INTERACTING WITH AFOREMENTIONED OUTFLOW/WARM FRONTAL VICINITY WHERE SHEAR/VORTICITY IS MAXIMIZED. ..GUYER.. 06/23/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH DAMAGING WINDS ARE MOST LIKELY TO IMPACT CENTRAL AND SRN NJ AND ADJACENT AREAS OF NRN MD AND DEL OVER THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS AS POTENT SQUALL LINE MOVES EAST.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: INTENSE STORMS HAVE CONSOLIDATED INTO A BOWING ARC FROM THE NORTHERN EXTENT OF CHESAPEAKE BAY TO THE DELAWARE RIVER. THE CONSOLIDATION OF THIS ACTIVITY INCREASES THE CHANCE FOR MORE WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WINDS. CONVECTION WILL MOVE EAST AT 40-50KT INTO PRONOUNCED INSTABILITY AXIS FROM DELMARVA TO CENTRAL NJ WHERE SFC TEMPERATURES HAVE CLIMBED INTO THE LOWER 90S F AND OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS DCAPE VALUES ARE IN EXCESS OF 1200 J PER KG. WITH CONVECTIVE LINE ORIENTED PERPENDICULAR TO 50-60KT MID-LEVEL JET AND MAGNITUDE OF DOWNSTREAM INSTABILITY...THE POTENTIAL FOR WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WINDS...LOCALLY IN EXCESS OF 70KT...APPEARS QUITE HIGH.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR ISOLATED SVR TSTMS SHOULD INCREASE THE NEXT COUPLE HRS OVER THE HIGH PLAINS OF NERN CO AND SERN/E-CNTRL WY. COVERAGE IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN LIMITED...WHICH MAKES WW ISSUANCE UNCERTAIN...BUT TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS A GRADUAL INCREASE IN TOWERING CU OCCURRING ALONG THE FRONT RANGE OF CO AS A MID-UPPER LEVEL MOISTURE PLUME OVERSPREADS THE REGION FROM THE SOUTHWEST. A FEW STRONG TO SVR STORMS COULD EVOLVE AND MOVE EWD OVER THE HIGH PLAINS IN THE NEXT COUPLE HRS...GIVEN STRONG HEATING OCCURRING WITHIN A MOIST AIR MASS...AND AN AXIS OF MLCAPE VALUES RANGING FROM 1500-2500 J/KG POSITIONED FROM ERN CO NWD TO NEAR THE NEB/WY BORDER. MODIFIED FORECAST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST WEAK CINH IS STILL IN PLACE...BUT THIS SHOULD CONTINUE TO DIMINISH THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON DUE TO ADDITIONAL HEATING AND DEEPER BOUNDARY-LAYER MIXING. STORM COVERAGE IS ALSO EXPECTED TO REMAIN RATHER LIMITED DUE TO GRADUAL MIDLEVEL HEIGHT RISES THAT ARE OCCURRING. HOWEVER...DEEP-LAYER SHEAR IS SUFFICIENTLY STRONG TO SUPPORT AN ISOLATED SUPERCELL OR TWO...WITH LARGE HAIL AND STRONG WINDS LIKELY TO BE THE PRIMARY THREATS. TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WW.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL CONTINUE TO POSE A THREAT FOR HAIL AND POSSIBLY A TORNADO ACROSS PARTS OF MA NORTH INTO NH AND EXTREME WESTERN MAINE IN THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS. THIS POTENTIAL WILL LIKELY DECREASE QUICKLY AFTER SUNSET.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A COLD FRONT FROM THE UPPER CT RIVER VALLEY SSW TO NWRN MA PROVIDES THE WRN LIMIT OF TSTM POTENTIAL ACROSS NRN NEW ENGLAND EARLY THIS EVENING. THE EASTERN LIMIT COMES IN THE FORM OF A WELL DEFINED WARM FRONT EAST OF THE NH/ME BORDER. A NARROW CORRIDOR OF MODEST INSTABILITY REMAINS BETWEEN THESE TWO SFC FEATURES WHERE LATEST OBJECTIVE DATA INDICATED POCKETS OF EFFECTIVE SRH ON THE ORDER OF 100-200 M2/S2. LIFT ALONG THE EWD ADVANCING COLD FRONT WILL CONTINUE TO PROMOTE TSTMS GIVEN WEAK INHIBITION...STRONG BACKGROUND ASCENT...AND SUFFICIENT INSTABILITY. WHILE A MORE LINEAR CONVECTIVE MODE APPEARS TO BE UNDERWAY ALONG THE COLD FRONT IN NRN NH...STORMS FURTHER SOUTH CONTINUE TO SHOW DISCRETE CHARACTER AND REMAIN CAPABLE OF PRODUCING MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND POSSIBLY A WEAK/BRIEF TORNADO. CELLS CROSSING THE WARM FRONT IN WRN ME COULD ALSO POSE A BRIEF TORNADO THREAT GIVEN LOCALLY ENHANCED/STRENGTHENED DIRECTIONAL SHEAR ON THE BOUNDARY...PRIOR TO TRACKING INTO A MORE STABLE AIRMASS WITH ERN EXTENT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE STORMS WILL SPREAD SOUTHEAST ACROSS NORTHERN DELMARVA REGION THIS EVENING. WIND GUSTS OF 50-60KT WILL BE PSBL WITH THESE STORMS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WHILE A MORE INTENSE BOW ECHO SPREAD RAPIDLY EAST OVER THE SOUTH JERSEY SHORE...A NEARLY SOLID BAND OF FLANKING STORMS CONTINUES TO SPREAD SOUTHEAST INTO A STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIRMASS ACROSS NRN DELMARVA REGION THIS EVENING. UNLIKE THE DECAYING BOW EAST OF NJ...THIS BAND OF STORMS WAS MORE ALIGNED WITH DEEP-LAYER WESTERLY FLOW EVIDENT IN KDOX VWP. NONETHELESS...SUFFICIENT SHEAR EXISTS TO AID/MAINTAIN UPDRAFT PERSISTENCE WITH A FEW STRONGER EMBEDDED CORES POSING THE GREATEST CHANCE OF SEVERE DOWNBURST WINDS. A BRIEF TORNADO CANNOT BE COMPLETELY RULED OUT WHERE THESE STRONGER CORES INTERSECT FINE LINES AND OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES AMIDST THE STRONGLY UNSTABLE AND WEAKLY CAPPED AIRMASS RESIDING OVER THE REGION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE STORM POSING PRIMARILY A DAMAGING WIND RISK REMAINS A POSSIBILITY ACROSS SOUTHERN/EASTERN PORTIONS OF WATCH 344 OVER THE NEXT HOUR OR SO. THIS LOCAL RISK MAY EXTEND BEYOND SCHEDULED WATCH EXPIRATION AT 0100 UTC/9PM EDT AND A LOCAL EXTENSION IN WATCH EXPIRATION TIME ACROSS PARTS OF CT APPEARS REASONABLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: OVER THE PAST HOUR...STORMS DEVELOPED ALONG THE COLD FRONT SETTLING INTO LITCHFIELD COUNTY CT SOUTHWEST TO DUTCHESS/ORANGE COUNTIES IN THE LOWER HUDSON VALLEY OF NY. HOWEVER...THE NY STORMS HAVE SINCE WEAKENED WHILE ANOTHER BAND OF STORMS OVER LI SOUND CONTINUES TRACKING EAST. AN ISOLATED SEVERE TSTM WIND EVENT REMAINS POSSIBLE IN A NARROW CORRIDOR ACROSS SOUTHERN CT FOR ANOTHER HOUR OR SO WHERE MODEST INSTABILITY REMAINS IN THE PRESENCE OF STRONG SHEAR...AND LIFT AHEAD OF THE SOUTHWARD ADVANCING COLD FRONT CAN MAINTAIN/PROMOTE A FEW STRONGER CONVECTIVE UPDRAFTS. LATEST HRRR DEPICTS CONVECTION SPREADING INTO THE AREA BETWEEN 0100-0200 UTC/10-11PM EDT SO A LOCAL WATCH EXTENSION FROM NEW HAVEN COUNTY EASTWARD MAY BE NEEDED. ..CARBIN.. 06/24/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS TO 50KT REMAIN A POSSIBILITY ACROSS THE TIDEWATER AREA OF VA OVER THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS AS THUNDERSTORMS DEVELOP SOUTHEASTWARD. HOWEVER...MORE WIDESPREAD THREAT APPEARS TO BE ON THE DECLINE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: OVERALL SEVERE WEATHER THREAT APPEARS TO BE ON THE DECLINE ACROSS EASTERN VA AS A COMPLEX OF THUNDERSTORMS SETTLES SOUTH/SOUTHEAST ACROSS THE TIDEWATER. ABUNDANT INSTABILITY REMAINS AHEAD OF THE CONVECTION AND COULD STILL FUEL LOCALLY INTENSE UPDRAFTS. THE LACK OF STRONGER SHEAR AND FORCING ACROSS THIS REGION WAS LIKELY RESULTING IN A MORE MULTICELLULAR CHARACTER TO THE STORMS WITH CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW NOW SPREADING WELL AHEAD OF SOME OF THE STRONGER UPDRAFTS. BOUNDARY/CELL MERGERS AND COLD POOL INTERACTIONS COULD STILL PROMOTE BRIEF MESOSCALE ENHANCEMENTS RESULTING SHORT-LIVED STRONGER WIND GUSTS GIVEN MAGNITUDE OF AMBIENT INSTABILITY BUT LATEST TRENDS SUGGEST WATCH SHOULD BE ALLOWED TO EXPIRE AT 0300 UTC/11 PM EDT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED LARGE HAIL MAY ACCOMPANY CONVECTION ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: NOCTURNAL LLJ IS BEGINNING TO INTENSIFY OVER WRN KS LATE THIS EVENING. LATEST SHORT-RANGE MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGESTS 850MB SPEEDS MAY APPROACH 50KT AS FLOW VEERS ACROSS WRN KS DURING THE PRE-DAWN HOURS. EARLIER CONVECTION THAT EVOLVED OFF THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF THE CNTRL ROCKIES HAS SINCE PROGRESSED INTO NERN CO/SWRN NEBRASKA...JUST NORTH OF SYNOPTIC BOUNDARY THAT IS DRAPED ALONG THE I-70 CORRIDOR. LATEST MRMS DATA SUGGESTS THIS ACTIVITY IS PRODUCING LARGE HAIL AT TIMES AND GIVEN THE STRENGTHENING LLJ WARM ADVECTION MAY DRIVE CONVECTION EWD ALONG THE NEBRASKA/KS BORDER. WILL CONTINUE TO MONITOR THIS REGION BUT UNLESS A LARGER COMPLEX EVOLVES OR TSTMS BECOME MORE INTENSE WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED. ..DARROW.. 06/24/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR SEVERE WEATHER IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE EARLY THIS MORNING WITH TSTMS DEVELOPING OVER THE REGION. CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR MESOSCALE ORGANIZATION OF STORMS WHICH COULD NECESSITATE A WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: IN RESPONSE TO INCREASING WAA AND ISENTROPIC ASCENT AT THE TERMINUS OF A NOCTURNALLY STRENGTHENING LLJ...ELEVATED TSTMS HAVE DEVELOPED FROM E OF SUX TO NEAR AND SW OF DSM AS OF 0520Z. OTHER STORMS WERE DEVELOPING AT THIS TIME DOWNSTREAM FROM A SMALL MCS NEAR MCK OVER CNTRL NEB /N OF GRI/. THESE LOW-LEVEL FORCING MECHANISMS WILL PERSIST /AND LIKELY STRENGTHEN/ OVER THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS...PROMOTING ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA. WHILE THE THERMODYNAMIC CHARACTERISTICS OF THE 00Z OAX AND TOP SOUNDINGS WERE NOT FAVORABLE FOR VIGOROUS UPDRAFT GROWTH...RICHER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE AS SAMPLED BY THE 00Z SGF SOUNDING WILL CONTINUE TO BE ADVECTED POLEWARD...CONTRIBUTING TO FURTHER DESTABILIZATION FOR MOST-UNSTABLE PARCELS. AND GIVEN THE STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND AMPLE EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR...THE SETUP WILL BE SUPPORTIVE OF STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS CAPABLE OF MAINLY LARGE HAIL. RECENT CONVECTION-ALLOWING MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGESTS THAT THE HIGHEST PROBABILITY FOR MESOSCALE ORGANIZATION OF STORMS IS OVER CNTRL INTO ERN NEB WHERE DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL COULD BECOME A CONCERN IN ADDITION TO THE HAIL THREAT. AS SUCH...CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WATCH ISSUANCE. ..MEAD.. 06/24/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SMALL CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS WILL MOVE EAST ACROSS THE WATCH AREA EARLY THIS MORNING WITH A RISK FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: FORCING FOR ASCENT/DCVA DOWNSTREAM FROM A SUBTLE SHORT-WAVE TROUGH MOVING THROUGH THE NRN INTERMOUNTAIN REGION IN CONCERT WITH LOW-LEVEL UPSLOPE FLOW HAS FOSTERED A SMALL CLUSTER OF TSTMS EARLY THIS MORNING OVER NERN WY. AND WHILE THE THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT IS CHARACTERIZED BY ONLY MARGINAL INSTABILITY...NON-HYDROSTATIC PRESSURE PERTURBATIONS --ARISING FROM THE STRONG VERTICAL SHEAR-- WILL CONTRIBUTE TO UPDRAFT INTENSITY AND A PROLONGED RISK FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS AS ACTIVITY SPREADS EWD INTO THE BLACK HILLS EARLY THIS MORNING. ..MEAD.. 06/24/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR SVR HAIL CONTINUES ACROSS THE WATCH AREA. A TRANSITION TO MORE OF A LINEAR MCS MAY BE UNDERWAY WITH SOME POTENTIAL FOR THE SVR THREAT TO MOVE E/SE OF THE WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY CONTINUES TO SHOW A CLUSTER OF TSTMS ACROSS WESTON CO WY WITH ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT ARCING FROM THIS CLUSTER EWD INTO SW SD. RECENT MESH DATA HAS SHOWN A PERSISTENT SIGNAL FOR 1.50 INCH HAIL WITHIN THE CLUSTER AND THE CELLULAR DEVELOPMENT AHEAD OF IT. ADDITIONALLY...RECENT RADAR TRENDS SUGGEST SOME UPSCALE GROWTH INTO MORE OF A LINEAR STORM MODE HAS BEEN REALIZED. GIVEN THE STRENGTH OF THE SHEAR OVER THE AREA /0-6 KM BULK SHEAR AROUND 50 KT/ AND STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...CONTINUED ORGANIZATION IS POSSIBLE WITH THE THREAT FOR SEVERE HAIL PERSISTING. LINEAR ORGANIZATION IS ALSO EXPECTED TO INCREASE THE SELY PROGRESSION OF THE STORMS WITH AT LEAST SOME POTENTIAL FOR STORMS TO EXIT THE WATCH AREA BEFORE EXPIRATION. AS SUCH...LOCAL WATCH EXTENSION AND/OR NEW DOWNSTREAM WATCH ISSUANCE MAY BE REQUIRED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE TSTM CONTINUE ACROSS THE WATCH AREA. THE WATCH IS CURRENTLY SCHEDULED TO END AT 11Z. HOWEVER...TRENDS ACROSS THE REGION WILL BE MONITORED FOR THE POTENTIAL NEED OF AN EXTENSION IN TIME FOR WW 347 OR POTENTIALLY A NEW WATCH IF THE THREAT ACROSS N-CNTRL NEB IS EXPECTED TO PERSIST.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SEWD MOTION OF THE TSTM CLUSTER ACROSS CUSTER...FALL RIVER...AND SHANNON COUNTIES IN SD HAS RECENTLY INCREASED WHILE THE CELLS DOWNSTREAM ACROSS SHANNON COUNTY WY AND NE SHERIDAN CO NEB HAVE MOST RECENTLY SHOWN AT LEAST SOME DECREASE IN STRENGTH. THE INITIALLY NEWD MOTION WITHIN THE CONVECTIVE BAND THAT DEVELOPED AS A RESULT OF ISENTROPIC ASCENT ACROSS NEB APPEARS TO HAVE SLOWED A BIT WITH THE PREVIOUSLY MENTIONED CELLS NOW MOVING MORE ELY. THIS TURN HAS KEPT SOME OF THIS ACTIVITY JUST S OF THE NEB BORDER /AND S OF WW 347/. THE SLIGHT VEERING ANTICIPATED WITH THE LOW-LEVEL JET AS WELL AS RECENT TRENDS DO NOT SUGGEST ADDITIONAL ACTIVITY WILL DEVELOP. HOWEVER...THE SEWD MOVING TSTM IN FALL RIVER WILL LIKELY TRACK ACROSS THE BORDER SOON.
